references.text: The Israelites camped on the plains of Moab, across the Jordan at Jericho - the same geographical location is mentioned here.
Moses and Eleazar spoke to the people on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho - an identical place reference.
The camp on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho, is mentioned as the gathering point.
The Lord spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho - the same introductory formula and location.
Commands and laws that the Lord gave Israel on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho - a concluding place reference.
Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo - the continuation of Israel's stay at this place.
The plains of Moab are mentioned as the place where Moses distributed the inheritance to the tribes.
